name: Handles Under Pressure
summary: Tighten your crossover, shoot mid-range makes, read a soft trap with a partner and finish with a tough dribble shuttle.

drills.name: Push-Pull Crossovers
drills.summary: Push the ball forward, pull it back and cross it over without losing your eyes.
steps: Start at the baseline in a low stance.
Push the ball out in front, then pull it back to your hip.
Cross it over low to the other hand.
Take two steps forward and repeat up the floor.
Come back with the other hand leading.

drills.name: Fifteen-Foot Arc Makes
drills.summary: Hit three makes from each spot on a 15-foot arc before you move on.
steps: Set 5 cones around the paint at 15 feet: both baselines, both wings and the top.
Shoot from the first cone. Get your own rebound.
Make 3 before you move to the next cone.
Go around once, then come back the other way.

drills.name: Soft Trap Escapes
drills.summary: Read a soft trap and pick the right escape: retreat, split or pass.
steps: Dribble at the wing. Your partner stands near the sideline.
Partner jogs at you with hands high. No reaching or contact.
If they cut off the sideline, retreat two dribbles and reset.
If they come too high, attack past their outside hip.
If they stay square, pick up the ball at the right time and fake a pass, then go.
Switch roles every 60 seconds.

drills.name: Half-Court Dribble Shuttles
drills.summary: Speed dribble shuttles to half court and back, keeping control when you're tired.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble to the free-throw line and back.
Speed dribble to half court and back.
Rest 20 seconds, then go again.
Use your weak hand on every other round.
